mapper.select: select cm.* from dc_bookmark b join dc_community cm on b.comm_no = cm.comm_no where b.m_no = #{m_no, jdbcType=INTEGER} order by b.bookmark_date desc
mapper.insert: insert into dc_bookmark(bookmark_no, bookmark_date, comm_no, m_no) values(dc_bookmark_seq.NEXTVAL, SYSDATE, #{comm_no}, #{m_no})
